name: Masque Muerte
description: The raging soul of a villainous masked wrestler.

abilities.name: Libre
abilities.description: The Masque Muerte can’t be Restrained.

abilities.name: Heel Turn
abilities.description: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a PC within Close range. On a success, the target must mark a Stress and is temporarily Vulnerable as the Masque Muerte assaults them with a string of insulting taunts.

abilities.name: Spectral Suplex
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to have the Masque Muerte suplex a Restrained PC, dealing 1d10+6 magic damage to them.

abilities.name: Unmasking Death
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to have the Masque Muerte momentarily remove their mask, revealing their horrifying face underneath. Each PC within Close range must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or mark a Stress.

abilities.name: Tag Team
abilities.description: When the Masque Muerte deals damage to a PC, you can spend a Fear to have a spectral wrestler appear and Pin the target until they escape with a successful Strength Roll. While Pinned, the target is Restrained and takes an extra 1d12 magic damage from the Masque Muerte’s attacks.
